news.mcacrime.heading: %s — Village News (day %s)

gamerule.mcaCrimeUseWorldRules.descripti: Off: all listed settings use the server COMMON config. On: all listed settings use this world’s game rules, including unchanged defaults. Use /crime rules import to preserve configured values.
gamerule.mcaCrimeDetection.description: Detect harmful acts against protected villagers.
gamerule.mcaCrimeObservations.descriptio: Allow new witness observations and player reports.
gamerule.mcaCrimeThieves.description: Enable Thief assignment and behavior; preserve historical cases and occupations.
gamerule.mcaCrimeNpcMugging.description: Allow new robberies. Turning this off safely ends active attempts.
gamerule.mcaCrimeSeriousNpcCrime.descrip: Reserved: serious NPC crime is not in this release, so this rule currently has no effect.
gamerule.mcaCrimePvpCrime.description: Count qualifying player-versus-player harm as crime.
gamerule.mcaCrimePlayerReports.descripti: Allow players to report server-recorded evidence to nearby guards. Requires observations.
gamerule.mcaCrimeThiefCombatPolicy.descr: 0: normal law. 1: evidence required. 2: all adult canonical Thieves, even after release. Children, guards and restrained prisoners remain protected. No evidence or reward is created.
gamerule.mcaCrimeNews.description: Deliver relevant digests through MCA mail. Personal preference and MCA mailing still apply.
gamerule.mcaCrimeNewsIntervalDays.descri: 1–30 Minecraft days of monotonic game time between editions.
gamerule.mcaCrimeNewsMaxStories.descript: 1–8 stories, subject to four-page and text limits.
gamerule.mcaCrimePlayerMugProtectionTick: 0–1728000 ticks for new protection grants; existing deadlines persist.
gamerule.mcaCrimeMaxMuggingsPerDay.descr: 0–64; zero means no cap, not disabled mugging.
gamerule.mcaCrimeThiefJailTicks.descript: 200–240000 ticks for new sentences. Existing sentences retain their assigned duration.
gamerule.mcaCrimeThiefProtectHotbar.desc: Prevent NPC theft of hotbar items; armor/offhand keep their config settings.

gui.mcacrime.action.frisk.desc: Go through a restrained subject's pockets. A lawful search seals what it takes as evidence; anything else is theft.
